function: The grid-area property specifies a grid item's size and location in a grid layout, and is a shorthand property for the following properties:
syntax: grid-area: grid-row-start / grid-column-start / grid-row-end / grid-column-end | itemname;

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Specifies on which row to start displaying the item.
Specifies on which column to start displaying the item.
Specifies on which row-line to stop displaying the item, or how many rows to span.
Specifies on which column-line to stop displaying the item, or how many columns to span.
Specifies a name for the grid item
